whatToWatch.text: This defense is the story: 8.5 points allowed per game through two weeks, and they're walking into a Washington team surrendering 30.5. Vegas noticed — Seattle's a 7-point road favorite at 2-0.

That 40.5 over/under is a bet that the Seahawks smother this thing. Both teams are getting to the quarterback at the same clip (2.5 sacks per game), so whoever's pass rush shows up first probably decides it.

Nobody's ruled out on either side, but five Seahawks carry a questionable tag — Cooper Kupp, Brady Russell and George Holani among them. Washington's watching Jeremy Reaves and Charles Omenihu. Check the inactives before kickoff.
